SELECT invoice_num, invoice_date, invoice_amount
FROM ap_invoices_all;
caption: AP_INVOICES_ALL — the real table behind the Manage Invoices page.
Oracle checks the condition for every row and keeps only the matches.
Oracle table aliases never use AS — that's a syntax error here, unlike most other databases.
